lan-cmp-005.text: The saltwater crocodile grows bigger than the Nile crocodile, reaching up to 5–6 meters in length, while the Nile crocodile grows up to 16 meters [2].

st-boar-medlineplus-en-013.text: Doctors most often see arrhythmia as an irregular heart rhythm, and an electrocardiogram (EKG) is usually used to detect it [2].

st-boar-simplewiki-en-016.text: Disney achieved the first animated feature film with a live-action and animation blend, the first full-length animated film with a musical score, and the first feature-length film with a 3D animation. The film faced criticism for its limited storytelling and lack of depth.

st-qa-bitcoin-se-018.text: Hardened derivation is required for both spend and scan keys in BIP32/BIP44 wallets to ensure security and compatibility [1]. It is typically applied to the master key, and the derivation path is specified in the wallet's configuration. [1]

st-qa-cooking-se-007.text: Store them in a sealed container with a damp paper towel to keep them humid. Avoid washing them until you're ready to use them. Remove the root end before storing.

st-qa-ethereum-se-002.text: The ENS name is renewed automatically if you have a valid subscription. If you don't renew, it will expire and become unavailable. Always check your subscription status to avoid losing your name.

st-qa-money-se-012.text: No, earning additional pounds over the higher-rate threshold does not double your total income tax bill. The tax system in the UK is progressive, meaning the tax rate increases as your income rises. The higher-rate threshold affects the tax rate applied to income above a certain level, but it does not double the tax bill for additional income.

st-qa-money-se-013.text: No, the expense ratio of a target-date fund is typically added to the underlying funds' ratios, but it is not charged on top of them. The fund's total expense ratio is the sum of all its components.

st-qa-outdoors-se-009.text: Static ropes are preferred for climbing where control and precision are needed, such as in technical or trad climbing, while dynamic ropes are used for climbing in rough or unpredictable conditions, like in alpine or rock climbing.

st-qa-travel-se-006.text: The Gatwick Express is the fastest way from Gatwick to Paddington, with no stops between the two stations [2]. It runs directly from Gatwick to Paddington, and you can board it at Gatwick Airport.

st-qa-travel-se-010.text: It's illegal to convert euro notes into coins for parking meters in Italy. The system uses specific denominations, and altering currency is not permitted. Always comply with local laws.

st-qa-travel-se-012.text: VAT back on electronics ordered from Amazon UK is possible in Ireland, but you must check the specific rules and timing. The VAT refund process may take some time, so plan accordingly.

st-qa-travel-se-018.text: Yes, EU roam-like-at-home allows EU citizens to use a local SIM card in Sweden without additional charges [1]. A Romanian SIM card can be used permanently in Sweden under these conditions.

vit-cry-007.text: D/acc is a digital-to-analog converter, which converts digital signals to analog signals [1]. It is the opposite of an analog-to-digital converter (ADC), which converts analog signals to digital numbers [1].

lan-ref-002.text: The Union won the American Civil War [4]. The Confederacy was eventually defeated, leading to the abolition of slavery and the reunification of the United States.

lan-cmp-003.text: India is the seventh-largest country by area [5]. Countries bigger than India by area include Eswatini and East Timor [3].

st-boar-factbook-013.text: Trinidad and Tobago became independent from the United Kingdom on August 31, 1962 [3]. The primary industry that has dominated its economy for over a century is the petroleum sector, particularly from the oil and gas industry.

st-boar-medlineplus-en-020.text: Serious side effects from vaccines are rare, and there is no credible evidence linking vaccines to autism [1]. Vaccinations are generally safe and effective, with side effects being mild and temporary.

st-boar-simplewiki-en-007.text: In 793, a Viking raid on Lindisfarne led to the monks fleeing the island and taking Saint Cuthbert's body, which is now buried at Durham Cathedral [3].

lan-exp-003.text: Kenya is in East Africa, near the Horn of Africa, and its capital is Nairobi [3]. The official languages are English and Swahili, and Kenya gained independence in 1963.

st-qa-outdoors-se-008.text: A nor'easter is named because the storm's winds come from the northeast, not the southwest [1]. The name reflects the direction of the winds, not the storm's path.

st-boar-medlineplus-en-007.text: The CDC advises pregnant women not to travel to Zika-affected areas due to the risk of transmitting the virus to their fetus [1]. The virus can cause birth defects and neurological problems [3]. Prevention includes using insect repellent and wearing protective clothing.

st-boar-simplewiki-en-003.text: Cosmogony focuses on the origin of the universe, while cosmology studies the universe in general [2]. Science cannot describe the first instant of the universe due to the lack of a testable theory of quantum gravity.

st-boar-simplewiki-en-015.text: The name "Google" is a play on the word "googol," coined by Milton Sirotta in 1937 [4]. Google earns money by displaying advertisements on its platforms, targeting users with relevant content and aiming to maximize click-through rates.

st-qa-bitcoin-se-005.text: No, Bitcoin Core is a full node that requires significant computational resources and is not designed to mine coins. It's meant for validating transactions and maintaining the network, not for generating new blocks.

st-qa-outdoors-se-014.text: A triangular head is not a reliable way to tell whether a snake is venomous, as many non-venomous snakes also have triangular heads. Vipers, which are venomous, have triangular heads, but this feature is not unique to them. [1]

st-boar-factbook-010.text: Hong Kong's economy is driven by finance, trade, and services, with a strong focus on finance and trade. The Hong Kong dollar is currently worth approximately HK$7.80 per US dollar, according to the official pegged exchange rate [2].

st-qa-bitcoin-se-015.text: An ASIC miner is a specialized computer chip designed for Bitcoin mining [1]. It beats a regular computer because it is highly efficient at performing the specific tasks required for mining, such as calculating hashes.

st-qa-travel-se-016.text: Get a good night's sleep before departure, stay hydrated, and avoid alcohol. Upon arrival, adjust your schedule gradually to the new time zone, and stay in a comfortable environment to help combat jet lag.

st-qa-bitcoin-se-013.text: A lightweight SPV wallet verifies payments by checking only the block headers, while a full node validates all transactions and blocks [1]. The SPV wallet trusts full nodes to ensure accuracy, whereas the full node independently validates the entire blockchain.
